observations: The first page of the additions and corrections, p. [233], without a page number. The heading «NACHTRÄGE UND BERICHTIGUNGEN» (L01), in capitals, stands below the top of the text block with a short rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «30» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line. The text of p. 232 does not show through; damp stains and the text of the next page, mirrored, in the upper third.

L09 and L11: the formulas are displayed, each in a line of its own, centred; the fractions are built up, written {fr:NUMERATOR|DENOMINATOR}; the square root of L09 is printed as a radical sign with a bar over «1 − (e1 sin m)²»; e, m, E, N and H in italics, the index 1 lowered; the minus sign printed as a dash, transcribed «−», as on p. 48 (JP2 0080). L24: «Cα», «C90», with the indices lowered, α in italics.

The first formula (L09) is that of p. 48 (JP2 0080, L20). The second (L11), as Suter describes it: with the centre H of the epicycle on a circle of radius 1 about the equant E′, the earth E at the distance 2e1 from E′ and m the mean anomaly at E′, the perpendicular EN on HE′ is 2e1 sin m and HN = 1 + 2e1 cos m. Pechüle's formula (L24-L26), Cα = C90 · sin α, makes the equation of the centre proportional to the sine of the argument.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Pechüle» (L04, L23), «Nallino» (L06, L18), «Batt.» (L06, L17), «Ptol.» (L07, L15), «Kh.» (L19, L24), «Ptol.-Batt.» (L20), «Heiberg» and «Manitius» (N01); «Kh.» in L21 is not spaced. Italics: «Prosthaphäresis», «Centrums», «Aequans» (L13; in L14-L15 upright), «Deferens» and the letters of the formulas and the figure. Bold: the number «1.» (L02). Dashes: «108—135» (L18) and «436—444» (N01) long (38 and 44 px); «261–265» (N01) short (21 px, broken).
